name: 🎛️ BP AI — Agent Control Center
description: Private live control center for Business Partner AI workforce: agents, tasks, deals, KPIs, pause/resume, autonomy and direct task commands.

parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body||$json||{}; const action=String(b.command_type||'').trim(); let route_index=3; if(action==='pause_agent'||action==='resume_agent')route_index=0; else if(action==='set_autonomy')route_index=1; else if(action==='create_task')route_index=2; const now=Date.now(); return {json:{command_id:'CMD-'+now+'-'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,7),command_type:action,target_type:String(b.target_type||'agent'),target_id:String(b.target_id||''),enabled:action==='resume_agent',agent_status:action==='resume_agent'?'active':'paused',paused_reason:action==='pause_agent'?String(b.reason||'Paused from Control Center'):'',autonomy_level:String(b.autonomy_level||''),objective:String(b.objective||'').trim(),context:String(b.context||'').trim(),client_name:String(b.client_name||'').trim(),priority:String(b.priority||'P2'),cash_stage:String(b.cash_stage||'non_revenue'),revenue_value:Number(b.revenue_value||0)||0,due_at:b.due_at?String(b.due_at):null,task_id:'CTL-'+now,route_index}};
